Plastic.hazardWarningEn: Non-biodegradable. Can release toxic microplastics and carcinogenic dioxins if burned in open air.
Plastic.hazardWarningHinglish: Plastic sadta nahi hai. Isko jalane par zehreela dhuaan nikalta hai jo lungs ke liye bohot harmful hai.
stepsEn: Empty any leftover liquids or food particles.
Rinse the container briefly with water and let it air-dry.
Crush plastic bottles or containers flat to compress volume.
Place into the Blue Dry Recyclables Bin or hand over to a registered scrap dealer (Kabadiwala).
stepsHinglish: Pehle andar ka bacha hua pani ya khana acche se nikal do.
Thoda paani daal kar dhokar sukhne do taaki badbu na aaye.
Bottle ya dabba crush (dabakar) flat kar lo taaki bin mein jagah bache.
Neelay (Blue) dry waste bin mein daalo ya local kabadiwale bhaiyya ko de do.
dosEn: Rinse clean bottles and food jars.
Flatten plastic bottles and tighten the cap back on.
Segregate rigid plastics (containers) from thin plastic wraps.
dontsEn: Do not burn plastics under any circumstances.
Do not throw greasy food-covered plastic without rinsing.
Do not mix medical syringes or chemical containers in ordinary plastic recycling.
dosHinglish: Bottles aur dabbo ko paani se saaf karke sukha kar daalo.
Bottles ko crush karke cap wapas laga do.
Hard plastic aur patli polythene ko alag alag rakho.
dontsHinglish: Plastic ko kabhi bhi mat jalao.
Bina dhule oily ya khane wale plastic ko dry bin mein mat daalo.
Hospital ke injections ya chemical wali bottle aam plastic mein mat milao.

Paper.hazardWarningEn: Paper is biodegradable, but wet or food-soiled paper cannot be recycled and contaminates the entire batch.
Paper.hazardWarningHinglish: Paper biodegradable hota hai par agar ispe tel ya geela kooda lag gaya toh yeh recycle nahi ho sakta.
stepsEn: Check that the paper is clean and free of food grease.
Flatten cartons, cardboard packaging, and corrugated boxes.
Remove wide plastic packing tapes and large metal clips.
Store dry and dispose into the Blue Recycling Bin or deliver to paper recyclers.
stepsHinglish: Dekho ki paper sookha ho aur uspar tel/masala na laga ho.
Cardboard boxes aur dabbon ko flat (chapat) kar lo.
Upar lagi plastic tape aur bade pin/staples hata do.
Neelay (Blue) dry bin mein daalo ya kabadiwale ko sell karo.
dosEn: Keep newspapers, magazines, and notebooks completely dry.
Flatten cardboard shipping boxes before disposal.
Shred sensitive personal documents.
dontsEn: Do not put pizza boxes with soaked grease into paper recycling.
Do not include wax-coated or thermocol-backed sheets.
Do not mix wet tissue papers or soiled napkins.
dosHinglish: Newspaper, copy-kitaab aur cartons ko sookha rakho.
Delivery boxes ko fold karke flat karo taaki kam space le.
Personal details wale papers ko faad kar ya shred karke daalo.
dontsHinglish: Tel se bhare pizza box ko paper recycle mein mat daalo.
Wax coated disposable cups ya thermocol paper ke saath mat milao.
Geela tissue paper ya use kiya hua napkin isme mat daalo.

Glass.binNameHinglish: Teal ya Blue Bin (Kanch Ka Kooda)
Glass.hazardWarningEn: Physical puncture and laceration hazard. Broken shards can severely injure sanitation workers.
Glass.hazardWarningHinglish: Toota kanch safai karmiyon ke haath aur paon mein chubh sakta hai. Bohot dhyan se pack karo.
stepsEn: Rinse out liquids, oils, or residue from the bottle or jar.
Separate plastic caps and metal lids.
If the item is unbroken, place it carefully in the designated glass bin.
If broken, securely wrap with multiple layers of old newspaper and label 'BROKEN GLASS' before disposal.
stepsHinglish: Kanch ki bottle ya jar ko paani se rinse kar lo.
Plastic ka dhakkan ya metal lid alag nikaal lo.
Agar kanch sahi salamat hai toh aaram se glass bin mein rakho.
Agar kanch toot chuka hai toh motay newspaper mein acche se lapeto aur upar 'BROKEN GLASS' likh kar rakho.
dosEn: Always wrap broken glass pieces securely before discarding.
Donate reusable glass mason jars for home storage.
Hand intact bottles over to local scrap collectors.
dontsEn: Do not throw loose shards into standard garbage bags.
Do not mix mirror glass, light bulbs, or tempered cookware (Borosil) with regular container glass.
Do not let children handle damaged glass items.
dosHinglish: Toota kanch hamesha newspaper ya box mein band karke feko.
Achhi bottles aur jars ko ghar par storage ke liye reuse karo.
Saabut bottles kabadiwale ko de do, wo bottle plant wapas bhejte hain.
dontsHinglish: Khula toota kanch kabhi bhi polythene mein mat phenko.
Mirror (aaina), bulbs ya oven wale glass ko regular glass bottle ke saath mix mat karo.
Bachho ko toota hua kanch na chhoone dein.

Metal.binNameHinglish: Grey ya Blue Bin (Dhaatu Aur Cans)
Metal.hazardWarningEn: Sharp cut edges on tin can lids. May cause cuts and tetanus risk if rusted.
Metal.hazardWarningHinglish: Cans ke teekhe kinare ungli kaat sakte hain. Jang lage lohe se tetanus ka khatra hota hai.
stepsEn: Rinse away any residue of food or sugary beverages.
Push sharp can lids inside the can or bend them safely.
Flatten aluminum cans to optimize bin capacity.
Deposit into the metal dry recyclable stream or scrap collection point.
stepsHinglish: Can ke andar ka juice ya khana dho kar saaf karo.
Dhakkan ke dhardaar kinaron ko can ke andar push kar do.
Cold drink cans ko per se daba kar flat kar lo.
Dry recycling bin ya kabadiwale bhaiyya ko de do, metal 100% recycle hota hai.
dosEn: Rinse aluminum drink cans, food cans, and clean metal foils.
Sort heavy iron/steel hardware separately from lightweight aluminum.
Sell bulk metals to certified scrap dealers for extra cash.
dontsEn: Do not leave sharp jagged can lids sticking out.
Do not dispose pressurized aerosol spray cans in regular scrap without depressurizing.
Do not mix chemical or motor oil containers.
dosHinglish: Beverage cans aur aluminium foil ko halka dho kar saaf daalo.
Bhaari loha aur patla aluminium alag alag rakho.
Metal scrap ko kabadiwale ko becho, accha paisa milta hai.
dontsHinglish: Can ke teekhe dhakkan ko khula bahar mat chhodo.
Deodorant spray cans ko kooday mein mat daalo jab tak puri tarah khali na ho.
Engine oil ya acid ke metal dibbe regular scrap mein mat dalo.

Organic.hazardWarningEn: Produces methane gas and leachate foul liquid when dumped in anaerobic landfills.
Organic.hazardWarningHinglish: Geela kooda polythene mein sadne se methane gas banti hai aur kooda se bura smell/keede hote hain.
stepsEn: Keep wet organic scraps strictly separate from plastics, paper, and metal.
Drain any excess soup or liquid gravy into the sink strainer.
Place food scraps, peels, and tea leaves into the Green Bin.
Compost at home in a terracotta pot or vermicompost bed if possible.
stepsHinglish: Sabzi ke chhilke, bacha khana aur chai patti ko dry waste se bilkul alag rakho.
Khane ka geela paani/gravy nikal kar strainer se drain karo.
Hare (Green) wet waste bin mein daalo ya compost pot mein daalo.
Ghar par khad bana sakte ho toh bagiche ke podhon ke liye best natural fertilizer banega.
dosEn: Segregate fruit rinds, vegetable trimmings, egg shells, and garden dry leaves.
Use newspaper lining instead of plastic garbage bags in your wet bin.
Feed edible leftover food to local community animal shelters when fresh.
dontsEn: Do not throw plastic wrappers, gutkha pouches, or rubber bands into wet waste.
Do not mix pet feces or litter into common kitchen compost.
Do not pour hazardous liquid chemicals into organic waste.
dosHinglish: Phal, sabzi ke chhilke, ande ke chilke aur chai patti hare bin mein daalo.
Dustbin ke andar plastic bag ki jagah newspaper ka use karo.
Bacha hua saaf khana street dogs ya gaushala mein donate karo.
dontsHinglish: Polythene, toffee wrapper ya rubber band geelay kooday mein mat daalo.
Kutte/billi ka poop kitchen waste ke saath mix mat karo.
Pesticide ya acid geelay kooday mein mat daalo.

E-waste.hazardWarningEn: Contains heavy neurotoxins including lead, mercury, cadmium, and brominated flame retardants.
E-waste.hazardWarningHinglish: Electronics mein lead, mercury aur cadmium jaise zehreelay tatva hote hain jo groundwater ko zehreela bana dete hain.
stepsEn: Power off the device and backup/wipe all personal data completely.
Remove detachable batteries and store them safely.
Do not dismantle circuit boards or crush screens at home.
Deliver to an authorized Pollution Control Board (CPCB) registered E-waste collector or brand EPR drop box.
stepsHinglish: Device ko switch off karo aur apna private data/photos wipe kar lo.
Agar battery bahar nikal sakti hai toh sambhal kar alag nikalo.
Ghar par circuit board todne ya screen todne ki koshish mat karo.
Authorised E-waste center ya electronics store (Croma/Reliance/Samsung) ke drop-box mein jama karo.
dosEn: Cover battery terminals with electrical tape to avoid sparks.
Check manufacturer exchange/buyback schemes when buying new gadgets.
Store broken cables and old chargers in a dry e-waste bag until disposal.
dontsEn: Never put old phones, remotes, or chargers into regular municipal trash bins.
Never burn electronic wires to extract copper.
Never give hazardous e-waste to unorganized child-labor or roadside acid extractors.
dosHinglish: Battery ke points par tape laga do taaki short-circuit na ho.
Naya phone/laptop lete time purana exchange scheme mein do.
Kharab charger aur cable alag bag mein jama karke E-waste center le jao.
dontsHinglish: Ghar ke regular dustbin mein kabhi bhi phone ya remote mat phenko.
Taambe (copper) ke liye taar ko kabhi aag mein mat jalao.
Acid se sona/copper nikalne wale roadside informal kabadiyon ko mat do.

Hazardous.hazardWarningEn: Biohazard, flammable, corrosive, or toxic. Poses immediate risk of infection, burns, or poisoning.
Hazardous.hazardWarningHinglish: Khatarnak infection, aag lagne ya zehreelay chemical ka khatra. Turant alag pack karein.
stepsEn: Handle with protective gloves or paper if the substance is chemical or bio-waste.
Keep in its original leak-proof container with clear warning labels.
Wrap bio-medical/sanitary waste in newspaper and mark with a red cross or red dot.
Hand over directly to specialized hazardous/biomedical waste handling agencies.
stepsHinglish: Hath mein gloves pehno ya sambhal kar pakdo taaki direct chemical skin par na lage.
Original dhakkan wale dabba mein hi rakho taaki leak na ho.
Sanitary waste/pads ko paper mein fold karke laal pen/marker se red cross mark karo.
Safai karmi ko alag se bolo ki yeh hazardous/sanitary kooda hai.
dosEn: Store batteries, paints, pesticides, and expired medicines separately.
Clearly mark biomedical items with a red indicator symbol.
Check expiration dates of chemicals before disposal.
dontsEn: Do not flush medicines or chemicals down the toilet or sink drains.
Do not puncture compressed aerosol cans or throw batteries in fire.
Do not mix bleach with ammonia-based cleaners (creates toxic chloramine gas).
dosHinglish: Battery, paint, keede-mar dawa aur expired dawai alag dabba mein rakho.
Sanitary pads/diapers ko paper mein acche se wrap karke red dot lagao.
Chemicals ko safe dry jagah bachho ki pahunch se door rakho.
dontsHinglish: Dawaiyon ya chemicals ko flush ya nali mein mat bahao.
Aerosol spray can mein chhed mat karo aur battery ko aag ke paas mat le jao.
Harpic/acid aur doosre chemicals ko aapas mein kabhi mix mat karo.

Textile.hazardWarningEn: Synthetic fibers (polyester, nylon) take 200+ years to decompose and emit microplastics.
Textile.hazardWarningHinglish: Polyester aur nylon ke kapde saalon tak sadte nahi hain aur zameen ko pollute karte hain.
stepsEn: Wash and dry the clothes or fabrics thoroughly.
Inspect condition: if wearable, fold and pack for charity donation.
If torn or ruined, cut into dusters/mops or keep for fiber regeneration.
Drop into clothing donation boxes (e.g., Goonj, Clothes Box Foundation) or textile recyclers.
stepsHinglish: Kapdo ko dho kar acche se sukha lo.
Check karo: agar pehan-ne layak hai toh daan (donation) ke liye alag rakho.
Agar fat chuka hai toh ghar ke ponche/duster bana lo ya scrap fabric banao.
NGO donation box (jaise Goonj) ya kapda recycle center mein drop karo.
dosEn: Donate clean, wearable clothing to local shelters or NGOs.
Repurpose worn cotton shirts into reusable kitchen towels.
Deliver discarded footwear and bags to specialized repair & upcycle centers.
dontsEn: Do not throw wearable clothes in municipal road dumpsters.
Do not burn synthetic clothes (releases toxic fumes).
Do not mix wet or mildewed clothes in donation bundles.
dosHinglish: Saaf kapde zarooratmand logon ko ya ashram mein donate karo.
Phate purane cotton t-shirts ko kitchen wipes ke roop mein reuse karo.
Purane joote aur bags ko mochi se theek karwa kar reuse karo.
dontsHinglish: Acche kapdo ko kooday-daan mein mat phenko.
Synthetic kapdo ko kabhi aag mein mat jalao.
Geelay fafundi lage kapdo ko donation mein mat bhejo.

Other.hazardWarningEn: Inert or composite items destined for scientific landfills or waste-to-energy incineration.
Other.hazardWarningHinglish: Yeh item recycle nahi hota aur landfill ya waste-to-energy plant mein jata hai.
stepsEn: Ensure the item does not contain hazardous chemicals, sharp glass, or rechargeable batteries.
Wrap sharp ceramics or porcelain safely in thick paper.
Place into the Black Bin for municipal landfill / RDF collection.
Consider replacing single-use composite materials with sustainable alternatives.
stepsHinglish: Pehle check karo ki isme koi battery, tez kanch ya chemical toh nahi hai.
Agar toota hua ceramic (cup/plate) hai toh paper mein wrap kar lo.
Kaale (Black) bin mein daalo jo municipal waste mein jayega.
Aage se disposable aur multi-layer packets ka use kam karne ki koshish karo.
dosEn: Keep inert household trash dry and separated from organics.
Check if local municipality sends black-bin waste to Refuse-Derived-Fuel (RDF) plants.
Wrap sharp broken crockery carefully.
dontsEn: Do not mix recyclables like clean PET bottles or cans in the black bin.
Do not put wet kitchen waste in the inert trash bin.
Do not dispose e-waste or batteries in the black bin.
dosHinglish: Ghar ke inert kooday ko dry rakho aur wet waste se door rakho.
Tootay hue chini mitti ke bartan ko paper mein lapet kar daalo.
Single use products ki jagah reusable cheezein apnao.
dontsHinglish: Clean plastic bottles aur cans ko black bin mein mat phenko.
Geela khana black bin mein mat daalo.
Battery ya charger ko black bin mein mat daalo.
